description: This file defines an interface and implementation for interacting with a build API, including methods for retrieving the latest build ID and downloading artifacts, along with auxiliary error handling and URL signing functionalities.

classes.name: BuildAPIError
classes.description: Custom error type representing errors received from the build API, including an error message and code.

classes.name: AndroidCIBuildAPI
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the BuildAPI interface for interacting with the Android CI build system, supporting retrieving latest build IDs and downloading artifacts.

methods.name: GetLatestGreenBuildID
methods.description: Fetches the latest successful build ID for the specified branch and target.

methods.name: DownloadArtifact
methods.description: Downloads the specified artifact from the build system.

methods.name: getSignedURL
methods.description: Retrieves a signed URL for downloading a specific artifact.

methods.name: doGETToWriter
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL and writes the response body to the provided writer.

methods.name: doGETToJSON
methods.description: Performs a GET request and decodes the JSON response into the provided structure.

methods.name: doGETCommon
methods.description: Executes a GET request with optional authorization and returns the HTTP response.

methods.name: parseErrorResponse
methods.description: Parses and returns an error from a non-200 HTTP response body.
